author: Digital Foundry
description:
It's the Digital Foundry Supporter Program that makes the DF Retro Super Show possible! Support the team, support the show, get high quality, ad-free video downloads of all DF content: https://patreon.com/digitalfoundry

The quartet is back in full force! John Linneman teams up with Audi Sorlie, Marc 'Try4ce' Duddleson and Coury Carlson to discuss the latest retro gaming - and associated - news, before tackling the main topic of the show, a retrospective on the most defining games for the incredible Sega Genesis/Mega Drive!

00:00 - Introduction
02:32 - Hideki Sato & Shutaro Iida
11:28 - Virtual Boy Switch Impressions
21:45 - Dragon Quest 7 Reimagined
26:07 - Rayman 30th Anniversary Impressions
35:53 - Main Topic - Defining Sega Genesis / Mega Drive Games (Round 1)
1:01:33 - Main Topic - Round 2
1:31:02 - Main Topic - Round 3
2:04:54 - Final Thoughts and Wrap up
title: DF Retro Super Show #008: Sega Genesis/Mega Drive - Its Most Defining Games
